title: Display
text: Display signal value during simulation, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the signal to connect and display signal connection, {Format}, {Format String} sets the custom string to format data, {Alignment} sets the text alignment, {Layout} sets how to arrange elements of non-scalar data Preserve, {Show grid for non-scalar signals} sets the whether to show grid, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color, {Background Color} sets the block background color and {Grid Color} sets the block grid color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Signal to connect and display signal connection options

params.name: Format
params.values: Format for displaying signal values short (default) | long | shortE | longE |...

params.name: Format String
params.values: Custom string to format data ’%d’ (default) | string

params.name: Alignment
params.values: Text alignment in block Center (default) | Left | Right

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Hide (default) | Bottom | Top

params.name: Layout
params.values: How to arrange elements of non-scalar data Preserve dimensions (default) | Fill available space

params.name: Show grid for non-scalar signals
params.values: Whether to show grid on (default) | off

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector

params.name: Grid Color
params.values: Block grid color [r g b] vector
